snippet.title: HELLKRAYNE Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo now on itch.io: fernel-studios.itch.io/hellkrayne

ABOUT THE GAME
Hellkrayne is a 2D isometric light incremental game where you play as a mighty warrior forged in magic and fury. Tap, grow stronger as you climb toward true power

- Genre: Incremental / Action / Clicker
- Art style: Isometric pixel art
- Demo length: 15-20 minutes
- Price: Free
